property_summary: Invariant: after any single call to play() the contract's pot is always congruent to 0 modulo TICKET_AMOUNT (i.e., pot % TICKET_AMOUNT == 0); the mutant that removes the require can accept arbitrary msg.value and can leave pot with a remainder not divisible by TICKET_AMOUNT, breaking the invariant for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require to accept any msg.value (removes ticket amount check), letting pot increase even with different payments which can alter pot after play.
